title: ReVisionLLM: Recursive Vision-Language Model for Temporal Grounding in Hour-Long Videos

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: ReVisionLLM: Recursive Vision-Language Model for Temporal Grounding in Hour-Long Videos Large language models (LLMs) excel at retrieving information from lengthy text, but their vision-language counterparts (VLMs) face difficulties with hour-long videos, especially for temporal grounding.

methods.name: Object/Event/Spatio-Temporal Modules
methods.evidence_sentence: Specifically, these VLMs are constrained by frame limitations, often losing essential temporal details needed for accurate event localization in extended video content.

methods.name: Uncertainty, Evidential Learning, and Calibration
methods.evidence_sentence: Furthermore, current VLMs often exhibit poor confidence calibration [25, 40], leading to frequent false positives with high confidence.

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training
methods.evidence_sentence: Recently, non-LLM-based models [15, 16, 39, 42] have made progress in long temporal video grounding.

methods.name: Coarse-to-Fine or Hierarchical Localization
methods.evidence_sentence: We also introduce a hierarchical training strategy that starts with short clips to capture distinct events and progressively extends to longer videos.
